rationale: Nathanaël brings deep CTO-level expertise in embedded systems and hardware-software integration (Python, MATLAB, VHDL), while Arfan has hands-on prototyping experience across medical devices, ingestible electronics, and IoT automation at Apple—complementary strengths in taking hardware concepts from design through systems integration. Both share IoT and embedded-systems domains with overlapping Python skills, making them well-positioned to explore technical collaboration or knowledge exchange on complex hardware challenges.
intro_message: Nathanaël BLAVO-BALLARIN, meet Arfan — you both work at the intersection of hardware prototyping and IoT systems, and your embedded-systems backgrounds could spark useful ideas around device design and integration.
